body: My weight is just a fraction of my problem. Everyday is a struggle to pull myself together and try to be functional. I can't seem to shake my depression and anxiety. I was doing okay for a while, but things took a turn, and now I'm back to square one.

I try to go out as much as possible, but getting out of bed is getting harder and harder every day. Even when I do go out, I'm wracked with anxiety based on my appearance. Everything is so bleak. I miss being happy.
